summary: The SCF class and the GenerateReport_SCF function are part of the HSPnet.ReportModel namespace, used to generate reports based on specific parameters like ProgramID and Logo details. The system ensures that logos are only included if they exist and handles report generation through a defined process.
purpose: The purpose of the SCF file is to define a model and a process for generating reports in the HSPnet application, focusing on parameters such as logos and program identifiers.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The name of the SCF report

fields.name: Logo
fields.description: The path to the logo file

fields.name: LogoHeight
fields.description: The specified maximum height for the logo

workflows.name: Generate Report
steps: Parse input parameters including ProgramID and logo information.
Verify if the logo file exists before including it.
Ensure the ProgramID is valid and obtain the program name.
Create an instance of the SCF model with parsed data.
Execute the MigraDoc reporting function with the model data.

business_rules: A logo file must exist in the file system to be used in the report.
ProgramID must be successfully parsed; otherwise, the report is not generated.
validations: Check if the logo file exists in the system.
Verify the successful parsing of the ProgramID.
conditions: Logo is only included if the file path exists.
ProgramID must not be zero for report generation.
system_behavior: Generates a report only if all parameters are valid.
Handles missing logo files by omitting them from the report.
exceptions: Returns an invalid parameter error if parsing fails.
